prompts.name: miraMasterPrompt
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character illustration for a Japanese fantasy RPG and subsequent Live2D rigging. Subject: Mira, a young adult female star-chart apprentice of Ashen Frontier. Redesign: pale silver-lavender long hair, violet eyes, quiet curious expression, midnight-blue and muted purple layered mage travel dress with refined antique gold celestial embroidery, small star clasp, leather waist belt holding a folded star chart and compact brass astrolabe. Elegant practical nonsexual costume. Bare head without a large hat so the face and hair can be rigged clearly. Composition: one character only, front-facing symmetrical relaxed standing pose, both arms relaxed slightly away from torso, hands visible, framed from the complete top of hair down to just below knees. Tall portrait canvas preferably 1024x1536; character centered with generous transparent margin on all sides. High-quality clean anime JRPG painted illustration, precise delicate line art, soft dimensional shading, detailed but restrained. Neutral diffuse light. Genuine transparent background and no shadow backdrop. No circle frame, no border, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no background objects. Eyes and mouth plainly visible and unobscured; hair locks and costume silhouette separated clearly for later Live2D decomposition.

prompts.name: miraBackHairPrompt
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one isolated Live2D rear-hair layer, same 1024x1536 transparent canvas as input. Input 1 is the exact identity and pixel-alignment reference for Mira. Extract ONLY her complete long silver-lavender BACK HAIR, including the full scalp hair volume and the long outer hair behind her shoulders, flowing down both sides to waist level. Remove all face, neck, eyes, body, clothes, arms, hands, accessories, ribbon, foreground bangs and front chest strands. Reconstruct the hair hidden by her head and torso into a continuous natural rear-hair silhouette. Preserve precisely the original hair color, linework, lighting, scale, position and original canvas dimensions; do not zoom or recenter. All remaining areas genuinely transparent. No text, no scene, no shadows on background. This layer will be placed BEHIND head and torso in a Live2D PSD.

prompts.name: miraBodyPrompt
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Live2D torso-and-costume base layer. Reference image is Mira's exact original art; preserve pixel alignment on identical 1024x1536 canvas, preserve original character scale and placement. KEEP ONLY all her body from the neck down, including clothing, collar, blue-purple sleeves, arms, visible hands, skirt, legs and boots, waist star chart and astrolabe. REMOVE the head and ALL HAIR, star head ornaments, hair ribbon, earrings. Paint in the costume, shoulders and collar areas originally hidden by the hair, matching the original embroidery, lighting and fabric. Keep the sleeves and hands unchanged. No severed-head imagery; this is a clean isolated character animation clothing/body layer with a natural neck at the top. Everything else fully transparent. Do not zoom or recenter. No text no shadow backdrop. Output one aligned body layer.

prompts.name: miraFacePrompt
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Live2D clean face/neck base layer for Mira. Use reference as exact identity, same delicate anime line art and complexion. Create only her front-facing skin head including forehead, both ears, face, nose, chin and neck, with all hair removed and the forehead completed. REMOVE eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows and mouth marks and replace their positions with smooth matching skin so separate eye and mouth layers can animate over it. Keep her face shape, nose and gentle blush faithful to the reference. Natural clean character asset, not a mask or mannequin; no costume, no jewelry, no body. Center the isolated head and neck on a square transparent canvas with enough margin; the face is upright and looking straight at viewer. Genuine transparent background outside the head and neck. No text, no border, no gray backdrop. This will be a base under separate facial features and hair layers.

prompts.name: miraFrontPrompt
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Live2D front-hair overlay layer of Mira. Reference is exact identity and original costume composition. Extract ONLY silver-lavender crown/front scalp hair, bangs across forehead, two face-framing side locks and slender strands cascading IN FRONT of chest to waist; include the little gold star ornament and dark-purple ribbon on viewer's right. REMOVE all face, skin, eyes, neck, clothes, rear hair volume behind shoulders, hands, body. Result is an isolated frontal hair cutout with an empty transparent opening for the face, no filled hair covering where eyes belong. Preserve original detailed strand shapes, same colors and delicate anime linework. One asset, transparent backdrop no text. Same 1024x1536 portrait proportions as the original; retain hair at top of canvas with chest strands descending to roughly 40% height; do not enlarge to fill canvas. No background or shadow backdrop.

prompts.name: miraEyesPrompt
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one facial eye-state sprite atlas for Mira's Live2D rig. Extract and faithfully redraw her two violet anime eyes and fine silver-brown eyebrows from reference. Transparent square canvas, a clean two-row two-column grid of FOUR isolated eye sprites with large empty margins between cells. Top-left: the eye on viewer's left, open, with iris highlights, sclera, eyelashes and eyebrow. Top-right: eye on viewer's right, open, matching size. Bottom-left: same viewer-left eye fully closed with curved eyelid line and eyebrow. Bottom-right: same viewer-right eye fully closed with curved eyelid line and eyebrow. Each cell centered at exact quarter-grid positions. All four eyes have the same width, maintain the reference's subtle kind expression and fine JRPG linework. Include only eye marks, eyeballs, lashes and brows. NO face skin patches, NO head, hair, body, labels, text, frames, guide lines or backdrop. Background and all empty space fully transparent. This is one production sprite atlas asset, not a composition of characters.

prompts.name: miraMouthPrompt
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a single mouth-state sprite atlas for Mira Live2D. Faithful fine anime mouth drawing matching the reference's delicate understated lips. Square transparent canvas, SIX isolated mouth marks in an evenly spaced two-row three-column grid. Top row left to right: neutral closed mouth, gentle closed smile, serious closed mouth. Bottom row left to right: small parted talking mouth, medium open talking mouth, wider open talking mouth. Each cell centered, same underlying mouth width about 150 pixels in a 1024-square canvas, generous transparent margins between cells. Open mouths have a dark interior and subtle tongue; no large teeth grin. NO head, nose, eyes, face outline, skin block, labels, guide lines, frames, logos or backdrop. Only isolated mouth ink and subtle lip shading, all surrounding pixels genuinely transparent. Production animation atlas, one asset.
